params.trade: Destination code, e.g. A=Alaska, C=Caribbean (see destinations). Comma-separate for several.
params.subTrade: Sub-region code, e.g. EM (seen on a Mediterranean ship card)
params.startPort: Departure port code, e.g. SEA, FLL (see ports)
params.port: Port code used by some home page cards, e.g. LAX, MIA
params.date: Departure month(s) as MMYY, comma-separated, e.g. 0627 = June 2027
params.ship: Two-letter ship code, e.g. RP = Royal Princess (see ships)
params.duration: Length in days as min_max, e.g. 7_7, 9_12
params.promos: Promotion code, e.g. 2GD (flash sale), RG1 (last minute), KHS (2028 early booking)
params.voyages: Comma-separated voyage codes (used by curated deal lists)
params.mrch: Merchandising flag added by home page cards (safe to omit)
